description: Lua-defined extensions added to `lje` and the safe environment during preinit.

constants.name: _G
constants.description: A reference to the original, unmodified global environment. Exposed in the safe environment so scripts can access globals that may have been shadowed or overwritten.

constants.name: _L
constants.description: A circular reference to the safe environment itself. Useful for passing the safe environment to functions that need an explicit reference to it.

constants.name: cloned_mts
constants.description: A map of cloned metatables, keyed by type name (e.g. `"Entity"`, `"Player"`, `"Vector"`). These are deep copies of the original metatables, remapped globally so LJE scripts use them instead of the originals.

constants.name: cloned_basemts
constants.description: A map of cloned base metatables for primitive types, keyed by type name. Currently contains `"string"`. Used by `lje.use_safe_basemts` and `lje.restore_basemts`.

constants.name: insecure_mts
constants.description: Stores the original (uncloned) base metatables when `lje.use_safe_basemts` is active, so they can be restored by `lje.restore_basemts`.

constants.name: lje.includeCache
constants.description: A per-script cache used by `lje.require`. Keyed by script name, then by path. Populated automatically — you generally do not need to interact with this directly.

functions.name: detour
functions.description: Creates a detour by marking `detourFn` as special and spoofing it to appear as `origFn` in debug introspection. If `origFn` is a C or fast function, JIT compilation is disabled on `detourFn` to prevent crashes.

params.name: origFn
params.description: The original function being detoured. Determines whether JIT must be disabled.

params.name: detourFn
params.description: Your replacement function. Will be marked special and spoofed to look like `origFn`.

functions.name: require
functions.description: A cached version of `lje.include`. The first call for a given `path` within a script context executes the file and caches the result. Subsequent calls return the cached value immediately. Must be called within an active script context.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the file to include, relative to the current script.

returns.description: The return value of the included file, or the cached result from a prior call.

functions.name: con_printf
functions.description:
A `string.format`-style console print with inline ANSI color support. Wrap text in `$colorName{...}` to colorize it.

Supported colors: `black`, `red`, `green`, `yellow`, `blue`, `magenta`, `cyan`, `white`, `default`.

Example:
```lua
lje.con_printf("$red{Error}: %s", message)
```

params.name: fmt
params.description: A `string.format` format string. Color codes use the syntax `$colorName{text}`.

functions.name: get_global
functions.description:
Safely traverses the original global environment (`_G`) using `rawget` at each step, following a variadic path of keys. Returns `nil` at the first missing or non-table intermediate value.

Example:
```lua
local fn = lje.get_global("hook", "Add")
```

params.description: A sequence of keys forming the path to traverse in `_G`.

returns.description: The value at the end of the path, or `nil` if any step is missing or not a table.

functions.name: get_global_static
functions.description:
Same behavior as `lje.get_global` but avoids the vararg allocation. Pass a pre-built table of keys and its length. Prefer this in hot paths where allocation matters.

Example:
```lua
local path = {"hook", "Add"}
local fn = lje.get_global_static(path, 2)
```

params.name: paths
params.description: An array of string keys forming the traversal path. Avoid creating this table dynamically, as that defeats the purpose of this function.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of keys in `paths` to traverse.

returns.description: The value at the end of the path, or `nil` if any step is missing or not a table.

functions.name: use_safe_basemts
functions.description: Swaps in the cloned base metatables for primitive types (currently `string`). The original metatables are saved in `insecure_mts` so they can be restored. Call `lje.restore_basemts` when done.
functions.deprecated: Old system before metatable remapping - no longer necessary or recommended.

functions.name: restore_basemts
functions.description: Restores the original base metatables saved by `lje.use_safe_basemts`. Has no effect if `use_safe_basemts` was not previously called.
functions.deprecated: Old system before metatable remapping - no longer necessary or recommended.
